about.title: About EasyDigia
about.intro: EasyDigia is a Moroccan agency founded in Marrakech, specialising in custom process automation and AI agents for SMEs. Over 3 years, we have delivered more than 50 projects in real estate, retail and industry, helping our clients save an average of 3 hours of manual work per week.
about.mission: Make intelligent automation and AI agents accessible to every business, regardless of size. We work where large agencies don't go: Moroccan SMEs that need concrete results, fast, with a controlled budget.
about.approach: We start with a free 30-minute audit to identify repetitive tasks and quick wins. We then deliver a first working version in under 2 weeks, training included. Every project is measured against jointly defined KPIs: time saved, errors avoided, revenue generated.
about.story: EasyDigia was founded in Marrakech in 2022 from a simple observation: automation and AI tools exist, but remain out of reach for Moroccan SMEs due to lack of tailored guidance. In 3 years, the agency has delivered 50+ projects in Morocco, France and Belgium, enabling clients to reduce manual tasks by an average of 60% and measurably improve their response time to customers.

values.title: Pragmatic innovation
values.desc: We use the best technologies available — GPT-4, Claude, Make, n8n — always in service of concrete, measurable results for your business, not to impress.

values.title: Measurable results

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know before starting your project with EasyDigia.

questions.q: What does automation mean for my business?
questions.a: Automation means delegating your repetitive tasks — follow-ups, data entry, reports — to intelligent workflows. The result: your team focuses on what creates value, while processes run on their own.
We primarily work with Make (formerly Integromat), n8n and Zapier for workflows, combined with custom APIs and AI models based on your specific needs.

questions.q: Does it work with my existing tools?
questions.a: Yes. We connect your existing tools (CRM, ERP, WhatsApp, email, Excel…) without forcing you to change everything. Our work integrates into your environment, not the other way around.

questions.q: What's the difference between a chatbot and an AI agent?
questions.a: A chatbot follows a fixed script and answers predefined questions. An AI agent understands context, makes decisions and acts autonomously — it can search for information, draft content, send messages and adapt to each situation.
Absolutely. We never share your data with third parties. Depending on the project, we can deploy models locally or in your own cloud environment for total control.

questions.q: Can the AI respond in Darija or Arabic?
questions.a: Yes. Our AI agents support French, classical Arabic, English and Moroccan Darija. You can configure the primary language based on your customer base.

questions.q: What is the average project timeline?
questions.a: Starter: 1 to 2 weeks. Growth: 3 to 5 weeks. Enterprise: 6 to 12 weeks. In all cases, a first functional version is delivered within 2 weeks for validation.
1) Free 30-min audit to understand your needs. 2) Custom proposal with quote. 3) Sprint-based development with regular check-ins. 4) Delivery + team training. 5) Included post-delivery support.
You get 30 to 60 days of included support (depending on the plan) to answer your questions and fix any bugs. A monthly maintenance contract is available for ongoing follow-up.

questions.q: What payment methods do you accept in Morocco?
questions.a: Bank transfer, certified cheque and Mobile Money (Maroc Telecom, Orange Money). A 50% deposit is required at kickoff, the balance due on final delivery.
